title: Steven Hahn v. Philadelphia Metro West Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC denied Hahn’s complaint, holding that Presbytery did not err by declining to institute process or appoint a prosecutor against Lisa Ridenour, RE Glen Ridenour, and TE Eric Huber.
first_summary: Hahn challenged Presbytery’s refusal to institute process against three church members he had accused. The SJC denied his complaint because Presbytery found that BCO 31-8 applied to Hahn’s conduct and that the evidence did not create a strong presumption of guilt. Deferring to Presbytery absent clear error, the SJC left its refusal to appoint a prosecutor and commence process undisturbed.
summary: Hahn challenged Presbytery’s refusal to institute process against three church members he had accused. The SJC denied his complaint because Presbytery found that BCO 31-8 applied to Hahn’s conduct and that the evidence did not create a strong presumption of guilt. Deferring to Presbytery absent clear error, the SJC left its refusal to appoint a prosecutor and commence process undisturbed. A concurrence agreed with the result but disputed the majority’s suggestion that filing charges generally requires process.

evidence_notes.identity_and_adoption: The issue and judgment identify Case 2011-15 at lines 228–234; the package was adopted 18-0 at lines 261–265 (printed pp. 515–516).
evidence_notes.dispute: Hahn complained that Presbytery wrongly refused to institute process against Lisa Ridenour, RE Ridenour, and TE Huber; lines 228–242 (printed pp. 515–516).
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: The judgment answered “No”; Presbytery applied BCO 31-8, found insufficient evidence of a strong presumption of guilt, and received deference absent clear error; lines 232–257 (printed pp. 515–516).
evidence_notes.qualifications: The concurrence agreed with the judgment but rejected any implication that filed charges generally compel process, while describing the case as narrowly decided under BCO 31-8; lines 269–298 (printed p. 517).
evidence_notes.incorporated_decisions: No decision was incorporated by reference. The concurrence discussed other cases only as judicial history; lines 329–380 (printed pp. 518–520).

source_limits: The operative decision is complete. The supplied text ends during the concurrence’s concluding discussion, but its material agreement and qualification are stated earlier.
